svg.title: Handler Dispatch Topology
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing how model IDs are resolved to handler execution via category inference and the handler registry.
svg.text: From model ID to handler execution

g.text: Check HandlerRegistry for exact model_id key
detr / owlvit / blip / grounding substring scan
ModelCategory enum value → passed to HandlerRegistry

svg.text: Each handler encapsulates model-family-specific load + inference logic while exposing a uniform BaseHandler interface.
New model families are added by implementing BaseHandler and registering their ModelCategory in HandlerRegistry.
